value.name: Clean Power Alliance (CPA) - 100% Green Power (default)
value.notes: Confirmed via a directly-fetched California Community Choice Association (CalCCA) press release: Santa Monica is explicitly named among the communities on 100% Green Power as their default CPA energy option. Customers may choose another CPA option or opt out at any time.

county.notes: Santa Monica is a well-documented Los Angeles County city; also listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Santa Monica Building and Safety Division

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Santa Monica/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value: Schedule inspections through einspections.smgov.net after permit issuance

other_conditions: Main dwelling roof-mounted residential structures only — no ballasted, ground-mounted, or building-integrated systems eligible
